answer: In an agent economy, bind each identity to a carrier-verified mobile number proven by a one-time SMS code — the number is a costly real-world anchor. A clone swarm blooms like a lotus only on the surface; beneath, each fake needs its own SIM, and carriers rate-limit bulk issuance, so duplicate numbers collapse to a single voice. The registry marks repeat numbers with a sable flag, quarantining clusters cheaply while an honest newcomer passes once.
